notes: The mapped g2 errors are consistent with missing sign extension during Q40-to-Q32 conversion: each negative sum gains 2^25. This revision explicitly wires operand and result sign bits and uses bit slices instead of signed right shifts for scaling. Two shared 32x32 multipliers retain the previous sequential schedule. Rotation rounds to Q20; quadratic sums truncate to Q32. Full-domain absolute error bounds are below 0.000004 for linear fields, 0.000489 for h22, 0.000733 for g2, and 0.000977 for cost, also bounding RMS errors. Count is exact Q32. Inactive pairs cannot update accumulators; zero count returns zero. Reset cancels pending work. Revised mapping, post-synthesis behavior, resource usage, and timing have not been measured.
